Definition: Jojarib, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"; 1) the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time; 2) a teacher in the time of Ezra; 3) a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah
